title: SimplySwords x MythicMetals
description: Enables MythicMetals compatibility for SimplySwords on Forge
body:
Enables MythicMetals compatibility for SimplySwords when MM is used with Connector mod. By default, SimplySwords only enables it on Fabric, meaning that Forge users wouldn't have weapon variants for new ore types.

This mod enables the feature which I found in the source code on GitHub that surprisingly isn't in the published SimplySwords jar.
